KHUSHI SURENDRA JAIN Investment Banking Operations | Capital Markets Operations | Trade Lifecycle | Investor Servicing.

+91 9975859990 • jainkhushi532@gmail.com• Andheri West, Mumbai, 400058, India • linkedin.com/in/khushi-jain-286ba3205

Open to Hybrid • Open to Onsite • Immediate Joiner

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Fund operations and investor servicing professional with 1.3+ years of experience supporting institutional clients across the trade lifecycle (listed & OTC) at a global investment bank's fund services arm. Skilled in processing subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, and switches, resolving investor and intermediary queries within SLA. Certified in Investment Banking Operations (CIBOP) and NISM Series VIII — Equity Derivatives, with hands-on exposure to capital markets, securities & derivatives, and financial instruments. Seeking to bring this trade lifecycle and client servicing background to a capital markets operations, investor relations, or client services role within an investment bank or asset management firm.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Associate – Hedge Fund Investor Services | Morgan Stanley Fund Services (via Optimum Solutions) Jan 2025 – Mar 2026 • Mumbai, India

Processed end-to-end investor transactions across the trade lifecycle — subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, and switches — for a high-volume institutional client book spanning multiple hedge fund structures, sustaining a zero-SLA-breach record for 13+ consecutive months, including through peak processing periods.

Coordinated with Middle Office, Fund Accounting, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to investigate and resolve transaction breaks and exceptions within SLA.

Supported OTC and listed securities lifecycle processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing and adherence to internal controls and operational procedures.

Monitored transaction status and escalated aged, high-priority and exception items to relevant stakeholders to minimize operational delays.

Acted as a key client-servicing point of contact, resolving complex investor and intermediary queries each month within defined SLA windows through structured root-cause analysis and clear written communication, while coordinating with Compliance, Fund Accounting, and Middle Office to drive closure and reduce recurrence.

Reviewed and validated investor onboarding documentation and regulatory standards; partnered with the KYC/AML team to introduce a checklist-driven review process that cut onboarding turnaround time by surfacing documentation gaps earlier in the cycle.

Maintained zero SLA breaches for 13+ consecutive months, including during peak-volume processing periods. • Prepared audit-ready reports and maintained accurate transaction records for institutional stakeholders • Maintained adherence to internal controls and regulatory guidelines across the transaction lifecycle by benchmarking processes against firm policy and industry regulation, escalating exceptions within SLA in partnership with Compliance, and preparing audit- ready, well-documented reports for institutional stakeholders.

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional (CIBOP) — Imarticus Learning, 2024 (Securities & Derivatives, Trade Lifecycle – Listed & OTC, Capital Markets)

Financial Modelling & Valuations (In Progress) — The Wall Street School, 2026 (Valuations: Market Approach & DCF; Three- Statement Modeling with Sensitivity Analysis; Industry & Competitive Benchmarking)

NISM Series VIII – Equity Derivatives Certification

CORE SKILLS

Operations: Capital Markets Operations, Trade Lifecycle (Listed & OTC), Trade Processing & Settlement, Fund Operations, Sub/Red/Transfer Processing, Transaction Validation, SLA Management, Internal Controls & Regulatory Compliance Client & Investor Servicing: Institutional Client Servicing, Investor Relations, Query Resolution, KYC/AML Review, Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional Collaboration Analytical & Technical: Financial Statement Analysis, Advanced Excel, MS Office Attributes: Ownership, Adaptability

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Commerce — 8.97 CGPI Malini Kishor Sanghvi College of Commerce & Economics (Ritambhara), Mumbai University, Mumbai, India | 2020 – 2023

HSC — 72.46% Malini Kishor Sanghvi College of Commerce & Economics (Ritambhara), India | 2019 – 2020

SSC — 85% J.M. Rathi English School, India | 2017 – 2018

LANGUAGES

English, Hindi (Read / Write / Speak)
